<script id="kb-night-hunt-v3">(()=>{
// The simulation is independent of rendering and uses seconds and logical pixels.
class NightHunt {
  constructor(width=1000,height=625,emit=()=>{},random=Math.random){
    this.random=random;this.emit=emit;this.width=width;this.height=height;
    this.phase='idle';this.duration=45;this.elapsed=0;this.score=0;this.hp=3;
    this.combo=0;this.multiplier=1;this.comboTime=0;this.boost=0;this.shake=0;
    this.flies=[];this.dogs=[];this.batteries=[];this.particles=[];this.popups=[];
    this.player={x:width*.5,y:height*.68,vx:0,vy:0,angle:-Math.PI/2};
    this.lightRadius=125;this.invulnerable=0;this.nextWave=10;this.nextBattery=11;
    this.collected=0;this.goldCollected=0;this.bestCombo=1;this.peakChain=0;
    this.stamina=100;this.exhausted=false;this.sprinting=false;this.freeze=0;this.blueCollected=0;this.obstacles=[];this.makeObstacles();this.motionReduced=false;this.scale=Math.max(.55,Math.min(1,Math.min(width,height)/520));
  }
  clamp(v,a,b){return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));}
  randomBetween(a,b){return a+(b-a)*this.random();}
  bounds(){return {left:35*this.scale,right:this.width-35*this.scale,top:this.height*.32,bottom:this.height-68*this.scale};}
  randomPosition(){const b=this.bounds();for(let i=0;i<80;i++){const p={x:this.randomBetween(b.left,b.right),y:this.randomBetween(b.top,b.bottom)};if(!this.blocked(p.x,p.y,24*this.scale))return p;}return {x:this.width*.5,y:this.height*.68};}
  setSize(width,height){
    const sx=width/this.width,sy=height/this.height;
    for(const p of [this.player,...this.flies,...this.dogs,...this.batteries,...this.particles,...this.popups]){p.x*=sx;p.y*=sy;if(p.trail)for(const t of p.trail){t.x*=sx;t.y*=sy;}}
    this.width=width;this.height=height;this.scale=Math.max(.55,Math.min(1,Math.min(width,height)/520));
    this.makeObstacles();this.lightRadius=(this.boost>0?205:125)*this.scale;
    const b=this.bounds();this.player.x=this.clamp(this.player.x,b.left,b.right);this.player.y=this.clamp(this.player.y,b.top,b.bottom);
  }
  start(){
    this.phase='playing';this.elapsed=0;this.score=0;this.hp=3;this.combo=0;this.multiplier=1;this.comboTime=0;this.boost=0;this.shake=0;this.invulnerable=1.25;
    this.flies=[];this.dogs=[];this.batteries=[];this.particles=[];this.popups=[];this.stamina=100;this.freeze=0;this.exhausted=false;this.blueCollected=0;this.makeObstacles();
    this.collected=0;this.goldCollected=0;this.bestCombo=1;this.peakChain=0;this.nextWave=10;this.nextBattery=11;
    Object.assign(this.player,{x:this.width*.5,y:this.height*.68,vx:0,vy:0,angle:-Math.PI/2});this.lightRadius=125*this.scale;
    for(let i=0;i<9;i++)this.spawnFly(i===0?'gold':i===1?'blue':'green');
    this.spawnDog(0);this.spawnDog(1);this.emit({type:'start'});
  }
  pause(reason='manual'){if(this.phase!=='playing')return false;this.phase='paused';this.player.vx=this.player.vy=0;this.emit({type:'pause',reason});return true;}
  resume(){if(this.phase!=='paused')return false;this.phase='playing';this.emit({type:'resume'});return true;}
  finish(reason){if(this.phase!=='playing')return;this.phase='over';this.player.vx=this.player.vy=0;this.emit({type:'end',reason,score:this.score,collected:this.collected,gold:this.goldCollected,combo:this.bestCombo});}
  spawnFly(kind=null){
    if(kind===true)kind='gold';else if(kind===false)kind='green';if(!kind){const r=this.random();kind=r<.16?'gold':r<.28?'blue':'green';}const gold=kind==='gold',blue=kind==='blue';const p=this.randomPosition(),life=gold?7.5:blue?12:999;
    this.flies.push({...p,kind,gold,blue,angle:this.random()*Math.PI*2,speed:this.randomBetween(gold?55:20,gold?85:43)*this.scale,phase:this.random()*6.28,life,maxLife:life,trail:[],trailTime:0});
  }
  spawnDog(side=this.dogs.length%4){
    const b=this.bounds(),pad=65*this.scale;
    let x=side%2===0?-pad:this.width+pad,y=this.randomBetween(b.top,b.bottom);
    if(side===2){x=this.randomBetween(b.left,b.right);y=b.top-pad;}if(side===3){x=this.randomBetween(b.left,b.right);y=this.height+pad;}
    if(Math.hypot(x-this.player.x,y-this.player.y)<180*this.scale)x=this.player.x<this.width/2?this.width+pad:-pad;
    this.dogs.push({x,y,angle:0,phase:this.random()*6.28,warning:0,lunge:0,cooldown:2.5,recover:0,offset:this.randomBetween(-.7,.7)});
  }
  spawnBattery(){
    let p=this.randomPosition();
    for(let i=0;i<18;i++){const candidate=this.randomPosition();if(this.dogs.every(d=>Math.hypot(d.x-candidate.x,d.y-candidate.y)>130*this.scale)){p=candidate;break;}}
    this.batteries.push({...p,life:10,maxLife:10,phase:this.random()*6.28});this.emit({type:'battery-spawn',...p});
  }
  illumination(x,y){
    const p=this.player,dx=x-p.x,dy=y-p.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy),angle=Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(Math.atan2(dy,dx)-p.angle),Math.cos(Math.atan2(dy,dx)-p.angle)));
    if(!this.lineClear(p,{x,y},1))return 0;const circle=this.clamp(1-d/this.lightRadius,0,1),reach=(this.boost>0?365:285)*this.scale;
    const cone=this.clamp(1-d/reach,0,1)*this.clamp(1-angle/.50,0,1);
    return Math.min(1,Math.max(circle*1.35,cone*1.4));
  }
  burst(x,y,color,count=12){
    for(let i=0;i<count&&this.particles.length<220;i++){const angle=this.random()*6.28,speed=this.randomBetween(18,100)*this.scale,life=this.randomBetween(.35,.9);this.particles.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(angle)*speed,vy:Math.sin(angle)*speed,color,life,maxLife:life,size:this.randomBetween(1.2,3)});}
  }
  collect(fly){
    this.combo=this.comboTime>0?this.combo+1:1;this.comboTime=2.25;
    this.multiplier=Math.min(4,1+Math.floor(this.combo/3));this.bestCombo=Math.max(this.bestCombo,this.multiplier);this.peakChain=Math.max(this.peakChain,this.combo);
    const amount=(fly.gold?3:1)*this.multiplier;this.score+=amount;this.collected++;if(fly.gold)this.goldCollected++;
    const color=fly.blue?'blue':fly.gold?'gold':'green';if(fly.blue){this.freeze=4;this.blueCollected++;this.emit({type:'freeze',seconds:4});}this.burst(fly.x,fly.y,color,fly.gold?18:10);
    this.popups.push({x:fly.x,y:fly.y,text:'+'+amount+(this.multiplier>1?' · ×'+this.multiplier:''),color,life:.9,maxLife:.9});
    this.emit({type:'collect',amount,gold:fly.gold,blue:fly.blue,multiplier:this.multiplier,chain:this.combo,x:fly.x,y:fly.y,score:this.score});
  }
  hit(dog){
    if(this.invulnerable>0||this.phase!=='playing')return false;
    this.hp--;this.invulnerable=1.65;this.shake=this.motionReduced?0:.55;this.combo=0;this.comboTime=0;this.multiplier=1;
    const p=this.player,dx=dog.x-p.x,dy=dog.y-p.y,L=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;dog.x=p.x+dx/L*190*this.scale;dog.y=p.y+dy/L*190*this.scale;const safe=this.safeTarget(dog);dog.x=safe.x;dog.y=safe.y;dog.recover=1;dog.lunge=0;
    this.burst(p.x,p.y,'red',16);this.emit({type:'hit',hp:this.hp});if(this.hp<=0)this.finish('dogs');return true;
  }
  step(dt,input={}){
    if(this.phase!=='playing')return;
    dt=this.clamp(dt,0,.05);this.elapsed=Math.min(this.duration,this.elapsed+dt);
    this.freeze=Math.max(0,this.freeze-dt);this.invulnerable=Math.max(0,this.invulnerable-dt);this.shake=Math.max(0,this.shake-dt);this.boost=Math.max(0,this.boost-dt);this.comboTime=Math.max(0,this.comboTime-dt);
    if(this.comboTime===0){this.combo=0;this.multiplier=1;}
    if(this.elapsed>=this.duration){this.finish('time');return;}
    const p=this.player,b=this.bounds();if(this.stamina<2)this.exhausted=true;if(this.stamina>24)this.exhausted=false;this.sprinting=!!input.sprint&&!this.exhausted&&(Math.hypot(input.x||0,input.y||0)>.1||input.target&&Math.hypot(input.target.x-p.x,input.target.y-p.y)>5);const speedFactor=this.sprinting?1.75:1;this.stamina=this.clamp(this.stamina+dt*(this.sprinting?-31:19),0,100);let vx=0,vy=0,dx=input.x||0,dy=input.y||0;
    if(dx||dy){const L=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(dx,dy));vx=dx/L*295*this.scale*speedFactor;vy=dy/L*295*this.scale*speedFactor;}
    else if(input.target){const tx=this.clamp(input.target.x,b.left,b.right),ty=this.clamp(input.target.y,b.top,b.bottom),L=Math.hypot(tx-p.x,ty-p.y),speed=Math.min(330*this.scale*speedFactor,L*14);if(L>1){vx=(tx-p.x)/L*speed;vy=(ty-p.y)/L*speed;}}
    const response=1-Math.exp(-dt*22);p.vx+=(vx-p.vx)*response;p.vy+=(vy-p.vy)*response;this.move(p,p.vx*dt,p.vy*dt,11*this.scale);p.x=this.clamp(p.x,b.left,b.right);p.y=this.clamp(p.y,b.top,b.bottom);
    if(Math.hypot(p.vx,p.vy)>8){const desired=Math.atan2(p.vy,p.vx);p.angle+=Math.atan2(Math.sin(desired-p.angle),Math.cos(desired-p.angle))*Math.min(1,dt*12);}
    const near=this.dogs.reduce((r,d)=>Math.min(r,Math.hypot(p.x-d.x,p.y-d.y)),Infinity),flicker=!this.motionReduced&&near<180*this.scale?1-(.018+.045*(1-near/(180*this.scale)))*(1+Math.sin(this.elapsed*37)*Math.sin(this.elapsed*19)):1;
    this.lightRadius+=((this.boost>0?205:125)*this.scale*flicker-this.lightRadius)*Math.min(1,dt*9);
    for(let i=this.flies.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const f=this.flies[i],dist=Math.hypot(f.x-p.x,f.y-p.y);f.phase+=dt*(f.gold?5:3);f.life-=dt;f.angle+=Math.sin(f.phase*.47+i)*dt*1.5;
      let fx=Math.cos(f.angle)*f.speed,fy=Math.sin(f.angle)*f.speed*.65;
      if(dist<90*this.scale&&dist>1){const escape=(1-dist/(90*this.scale))*(f.gold?50:26)*this.scale;fx+=(f.x-p.x)/dist*escape;fy+=(f.y-p.y)/dist*escape;}
      if(this.blocked(f.x+fx*dt,f.y+fy*dt,3)){f.angle+=Math.PI*.65;}else {f.x+=fx*dt;f.y+=fy*dt;}if(f.x<b.left||f.x>b.right)f.angle=Math.PI-f.angle;if(f.y<b.top||f.y>b.bottom)f.angle=-f.angle;f.x=this.clamp(f.x,b.left,b.right);f.y=this.clamp(f.y,b.top,b.bottom);
      f.trailTime+=dt;if(f.trailTime>.04){f.trailTime=0;f.trail.push({x:f.x,y:f.y});if(f.trail.length>11)f.trail.shift();}
      const pickup=(this.boost>0?34:26)*this.scale;
      if(Math.hypot(f.x-p.x,f.y-p.y)<pickup&&this.lineClear(p,f,0)){this.collect(f);this.flies.splice(i,1);this.spawnFly();}
      else if(f.life<=0){this.burst(f.x,f.y,'gold',6);this.flies.splice(i,1);this.spawnFly();}
    }
    for(let i=this.batteries.length-1;i>=0;i--){const cell=this.batteries[i];cell.life-=dt;cell.phase+=dt*2;
      if(Math.hypot(cell.x-p.x,cell.y-p.y)<32*this.scale){this.boost=5;this.burst(cell.x,cell.y,'cyan',18);this.emit({type:'boost',seconds:5});this.batteries.splice(i,1);}
      else if(cell.life<=0)this.batteries.splice(i,1);
    }
    if(this.elapsed>=this.nextWave&&this.dogs.length<5){this.nextWave+=10;this.spawnDog();this.emit({type:'wave',count:this.dogs.length});}
    if(this.elapsed>=this.nextBattery){this.nextBattery+=14;this.spawnBattery();}
    for(const d of this.dogs){
      if(this.freeze>0){d.lunge=0;d.phase+=dt*.4;continue;}d.warning=Math.max(0,d.warning-dt);d.cooldown=Math.max(0,d.cooldown-dt);d.lunge=Math.max(0,d.lunge-dt);d.recover=Math.max(0,d.recover-dt);
      const lead=this.clamp(Math.hypot(p.x-d.x,p.y-d.y)/480,.16,.78),idx=this.dogs.indexOf(d),side=idx%3-1,vl=Math.hypot(p.vx,p.vy)||1,goal=this.safeTarget({x:p.x+p.vx*lead-p.vy/vl*side*50*this.scale,y:p.y+p.vy*lead+p.vx/vl*side*50*this.scale}),dx=goal.x-d.x,dy=goal.y-d.y,L=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,dist=Math.hypot(p.x-d.x,p.y-d.y),light=this.illumination(d.x,d.y);
      if(dist<190*this.scale&&d.warning===0&&d.recover===0){d.warning=2.7+this.random()*1.5;this.emit({type:'bark',volume:this.clamp(1-dist/(230*this.scale),.08,1),pan:this.clamp((d.x-p.x)/(220*this.scale),-1,1)});}
      if(dist<115*this.scale&&d.cooldown===0&&d.recover===0){d.lunge=.65;d.cooldown=3.5;}
      const speed=(71+this.elapsed*.65)*(d.lunge>0?1.55:1)*(light>.65?.87:1)*(d.recover>0?.15:1)*this.scale;
      const desired=Math.atan2(dy,dx);d.angle+=Math.atan2(Math.sin(desired-d.angle),Math.cos(desired-d.angle))*Math.min(1,dt*7);let dest=goal;d.repath=(d.repath||0)-dt;if(!this.lineClear(d,goal,15*this.scale)){if(d.repath<=0||!d.path){d.path=this.path(d,goal);d.repath=.45+idx*.03;}while(d.path.length>1&&Math.hypot(d.x-d.path[0].x,d.y-d.path[0].y)<16*this.scale)d.path.shift();dest=d.path[0]||goal;}const dl=Math.hypot(dest.x-d.x,dest.y-d.y)||1;this.move(d,(dest.x-d.x)/dl*speed*dt,(dest.y-d.y)/dl*speed*dt,15*this.scale);d.phase+=dt*(d.lunge>0?18:12);
      if(Math.hypot(p.x-d.x,p.y-d.y)<26*this.scale)this.hit(d);if(this.phase!=='playing')break;
    }
    for(let i=this.particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){const q=this.particles[i];q.life-=dt;if(q.life<=0){this.particles.splice(i,1);continue;}q.x+=q.vx*dt;q.y+=q.vy*dt;q.vx*=Math.exp(-dt*2);q.vy-=dt*8;}
    for(let i=this.popups.length-1;i>=0;i--){const q=this.popups[i];q.life-=dt;q.y-=dt*24*this.scale;if(q.life<=0)this.popups.splice(i,1);}
  }
  makeObstacles(){const w=this.width,h=this.height;this.obstacles=[{kind:'tree',x:w*.23,y:h*.57,r:20},{kind:'tree',x:w*.77,y:h*.54,r:23},{kind:'tree',x:w*.38,y:h*.79,r:19},{kind:'tree',x:w*.83,y:h*.84,r:24},{kind:'bench',x:w*.54,y:h*.53,w:100,h:25},{kind:'bench',x:w*.15,y:h*.81,w:92,h:24}].map(o=>({...o,r:(o.r||0)*Math.max(.6,Math.min(1,w/1000)),w:(o.w||0)*Math.max(.6,Math.min(1,w/1000)),h:(o.h||0)*Math.max(.6,Math.min(1,w/1000))}));}
  blocked(x,y,r=0){return this.obstacles.some(o=>o.kind==='tree'?Math.hypot(x-o.x,y-o.y)<o.r+r:x>o.x-o.w/2-r&&x<o.x+o.w/2+r&&y>o.y-o.h/2-r&&y<o.y+o.h/2+r);}
  move(p,dx,dy,r){const n=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.hypot(dx,dy)/7));for(let i=0;i<n;i++){if(!this.blocked(p.x+dx/n,p.y,r))p.x+=dx/n;if(!this.blocked(p.x,p.y+dy/n,r))p.y+=dy/n;}}
  lineClear(a,b,r=0){const n=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y)/8));for(let i=1;i<=n;i++)if(this.blocked(a.x+(b.x-a.x)*i/n,a.y+(b.y-a.y)*i/n,r))return false;return true;}
  safeTarget(p){const b=this.bounds();p={x:this.clamp(p.x,b.left,b.right),y:this.clamp(p.y,b.top,b.bottom)};if(!this.blocked(p.x,p.y,16*this.scale))return p;for(let r=22;r<100;r+=16)for(let i=0;i<12;i++){const x=p.x+Math.cos(i*Math.PI/6)*r,y=p.y+Math.sin(i*Math.PI/6)*r;if(x>=b.left&&x<=b.right&&y>=b.top&&y<=b.bottom&&!this.blocked(x,y,16*this.scale))return {x,y};}return {x:this.player.x,y:this.player.y};}
  path(from,to){const b=this.bounds(),cell=32*this.scale,W=Math.ceil((b.right-b.left)/cell),H=Math.ceil((b.bottom-b.top)/cell),pt=i=>({x:b.left+(i%W+.5)*cell,y:b.top+(Math.floor(i/W)+.5)*cell}),key=p=>this.clamp(Math.floor((p.y-b.top)/cell),0,H-1)*W+this.clamp(Math.floor((p.x-b.left)/cell),0,W-1),start=key(from),goal=key(to),g=new Float32Array(W*H).fill(Infinity),prev=new Int32Array(W*H).fill(-1),closed=new Uint8Array(W*H),open=[start];g[start]=0;let end=start,best=Infinity;
   while(open.length){let k=0,score=Infinity;for(let i=0;i<open.length;i++){const q=pt(open[i]),s=g[open[i]]+Math.hypot(q.x-to.x,q.y-to.y);if(s<score){score=s;k=i;}}const u=open.splice(k,1)[0];if(closed[u])continue;closed[u]=1;const A=pt(u),dist=Math.hypot(A.x-to.x,A.y-to.y);if(dist<best){best=dist;end=u;}if(u===goal||dist<cell)break;for(let yy=-1;yy<=1;yy++)for(let xx=-1;xx<=1;xx++){if(!xx&&!yy)continue;const x=u%W+xx,y=Math.floor(u/W)+yy;if(x<0||x>=W||y<0||y>=H)continue;const v=y*W+x,B=pt(v);if(closed[v]||this.blocked(B.x,B.y,15*this.scale)||!this.lineClear(A,B,15*this.scale))continue;const cost=g[u]+cell*Math.hypot(xx,yy);if(cost<g[v]){g[v]=cost;prev[v]=u;open.push(v);}}}
   const result=[];for(let u=end,n=0;u>=0&&n<W*H;n++,u=prev[u])result.push(pt(u));result.reverse();if(result.length&&this.lineClear(result[result.length-1],to,15*this.scale))result.push(to);return result;
  }

}

function seeded(seed){let n=seed>>>0;return()=>((n=(Math.imul(n,1664525)+1013904223)>>>0)/4294967296);}
function rounded(g,x,y,w,h,r=5){g.beginPath();g.moveTo(x+r,y);g.lineTo(x+w-r,y);g.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+r);g.lineTo(x+w,y+h-r);g.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y+h,x+w-r,y+h);g.lineTo(x+r,y+h);g.quadraticCurveTo(x,y+h,x,y+h-r);g.lineTo(x,y+r);g.quadraticCurveTo(x,y,x+r,y);g.closePath();}
function pine(g,x,y,s,color='#31493c'){
  g.fillStyle='#675c48';g.fillRect(x-s*.065,y-s*.16,s*.13,s*.24);g.fillStyle=color;
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const w=s*(.45-i*.07),yy=y-s*(.22+i*.15);g.beginPath();g.moveTo(x,yy-s*.45);g.lineTo(x+w,yy+s*.13);g.lineTo(x-w,yy+s*.13);g.closePath();g.fill();}
}
function layer(paint){const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=Math.ceil((width+160)*pixelX);cv.height=Math.ceil((height+120)*pixelY);const c=cv.getContext('2d');c.setTransform(pixelX,0,0,pixelY,80*pixelX,60*pixelY);paint(c);return cv;}
function buildBackdrop(){
  const R=seeded(33819),h=height,w=width;stars.length=0;for(let i=0;i<65;i++)stars.push({x:R()*w,y:R()*h*.35,r:.4+R()*1.0,phase:R()*6.28});
  bg.far=layer(g=>{
    const sky=g.createLinearGradient(0,-60,0,h);sky.addColorStop(0,'#142d3c');sky.addColorStop(.43,'#3b5555');sky.addColorStop(1,'#172c29');g.fillStyle=sky;g.fillRect(-80,-60,w+160,h+120);
    const mx=w*.79,my=h*.14,mr=Math.min(w,h)*.04,halo=g.createRadialGradient(mx,my,mr*.2,mx,my,mr*5);halo.addColorStop(0,'#b9cfb338');halo.addColorStop(1,'#a5cbbb00');g.fillStyle=halo;g.fillRect(mx-mr*5,my-mr*5,mr*10,mr*10);g.fillStyle='#bac5aa';g.beginPath();g.arc(mx,my,mr,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill();g.fillStyle='#1d3541';g.beginPath();g.arc(mx+mr*.38,my-mr*.17,mr*.91,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill();

function resize(){const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.width<2||r.height<2)return;const dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,document.documentElement.classList.contains('kb5-eco')?1:1.6);const nextW=1000,nextH=1000*r.height/r.width;
  width=nextW;height=nextH;canvas.width=Math.max(2,Math.round(r.width*dpr));canvas.height=Math.max(2,Math.round(r.height*dpr));pixelX=canvas.width/width;pixelY=canvas.height/height;darkness.width=canvas.width;darkness.height=canvas.height;game.setSize(width,height);buildBackdrop();render(performance.now()/1000);wake();}

  g.lineCap='round';for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const x=i<2?-16:17,swing=Math.sin(d.phase+(i%2?Math.PI:0))*(d.lunge>0?16:12);g.strokeStyle=i%2?'#3e4b3c':'#57614b';g.lineWidth=6;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(x,-14);g.lineTo(x+swing*.4,-5);g.lineTo(x-swing,4);g.stroke();g.fillStyle='#273b2f';g.fillRect(x-swing-3,1,9,4);}

  g.fillStyle='#76806a';g.beginPath();g.moveTo(12,-25);g.lineTo(17,-38);g.lineTo(22,-48);g.lineTo(29,-39);g.lineTo(37,-38);g.lineTo(43,-26);g.lineTo(35,-17);g.lineTo(23,-18);g.closePath();g.fill();g.fillStyle='#3c4d3d';g.beginPath();g.moveTo(20,-39);g.lineTo(22,-48);g.lineTo(26,-38);g.fill();g.fillStyle='#a2a080';rounded(g,30,-29,17,9,3);g.fill();g.fillStyle='#1d2e25';g.fillRect(43,-28,5,5);g.strokeStyle='#334633';g.lineWidth=2;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(0,-30);g.lineTo(12,-27);g.stroke();g.restore();

function miniSegments(){return game.obstacles.flatMap(o=>o.kind==='tree'?KBLight2D.circle(o.x,o.y,o.r,8,10):KBLight2D.rectangle(o.x-o.w/2,o.y-o.h/2,o.w,o.h,2));}
function lighting(t){const p=game.player,r=game.lightRadius,eco=document.documentElement.classList.contains('kb5-eco'),reach=(game.boost>0?365:285)*game.scale;if(t-miniLightAt>.3||Math.hypot(p.x-miniLightX,p.y-miniLightY)>2||Math.abs(miniLight.range-reach)>1){miniLight.configure(p.x,p.y,reach,miniSegments(),eco?128:240);miniLightAt=t;miniLightX=p.x;miniLightY=p.y;}
 dark.setTransform(pixelX,0,0,pixelY,0,0);dark.clearRect(0,0,width,height);dark.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';dark.fillStyle='#020a0cbb';dark.fillRect(0,0,width,height);dark.globalCompositeOperation='destination-out';
 if(miniFullSerial!==miniLight.serial){miniFullSerial=miniLight.serial;miniFullFan=miniLight.polygon(0,Math.PI,!eco);}const fk=miniLight.serial+':'+Math.round(p.angle*300)+':'+eco;if(fk!==miniFanKey){miniFanKey=fk;miniConeFan=miniLight.polygon(p.angle,.54,!eco);}const full=miniFullFan,cone=miniConeFan;dark.save();KBLight2D.path(dark,full);dark.clip();const near=dark.createRadialGradient(p.x,p.y,0,p.x,p.y,r);near.addColorStop(0,'#ffffffff');near.addColorStop(.5,'#ffffffb0');near.addColorStop(1,'#ffffff00');dark.fillStyle=near;dark.fillRect(p.x-r,p.y-r,r*2,r*2);dark.restore();
 dark.save();KBLight2D.path(dark,cone);dark.clip();for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const spread=.54-i*.065,g=dark.createRadialGradient(p.x,p.y,0,p.x,p.y,reach);g.addColorStop(0,'#ffffff70');g.addColorStop(.5,'#ffffff42');g.addColorStop(1,'#ffffff00');dark.fillStyle=g;dark.beginPath();dark.moveTo(p.x,p.y);dark.arc(p.x,p.y,reach,p.angle-spread,p.angle+spread);dark.closePath();dark.fill();}dark.restore();dark.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';ctx.drawImage(darkness,0,0,width,height);

    if(f.gold){ctx.strokeStyle='#a08a4b66';ctx.lineWidth=1.2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(f.x,f.y,12*game.scale,0,6.28);ctx.stroke();ctx.strokeStyle='#dfbd66';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(f.x,f.y,12*game.scale,-Math.PI/2,-Math.PI/2+6.28*f.life/f.maxLife);ctx.stroke();}

}
function setupAudio(){if(audioReady){audio?.resume().catch(()=>{});return;}try{const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!AC)return;audio=new AC();master=audio.createGain();master.gain.value=muted?0:.6;master.connect(audio.destination);const n=audio.sampleRate*2,b=audio.createBuffer(1,n,audio.sampleRate),samples=b.getChannelData(0),R=seeded(55221);for(let i=0;i<n;i++)samples[i]=(R()*2-1)*.28;const src=audio.createBufferSource(),filter=audio.createBiquadFilter();wind=audio.createGain();wind.gain.value=0;src.buffer=b;src.loop=true;filter.type='lowpass';filter.frequency.value=360;src.connect(filter);filter.connect(wind);wind.connect(master);src.start();audioReady=true;audio.resume().catch(()=>{});}catch(_){}}
function audioSync(){if(master){master.gain.setTargetAtTime(muted?0:.6,audio.currentTime,.04);wind.gain.setTargetAtTime(game.phase==='playing'&&!muted?.075:0,audio.currentTime,.15);}}
function sound(type,pan=0,volume=1){if(muted||!audio||audio.state!=='running')return;try{const t=audio.currentTime,o=audio.createOscillator(),gain=audio.createGain(),panner=audio.createStereoPanner?audio.createStereoPanner():null,spec={collect:[650,920,.12,.06,'sine'],gold:[880,1760,.22,.065,'sine'],boost:[440,1120,.38,.05,'triangle'],hit:[100,37,.28,.10,'triangle'],bark:[160,56,.30,.09,'sawtooth'],end:[500,220,.55,.045,'sine']}[type];if(!spec)return;o.type=spec[4];o.frequency.setValueAtTime(spec[0],t);o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(spec[1],t+spec[2]);gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t);gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(spec[3]*volume,t+.025);if(type==='bark'){gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.002,t+.11);gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(spec[3]*volume*.7,t+.15);}gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+spec[2]);o.connect(gain);if(panner){panner.pan.value=pan;gain.connect(panner);panner.connect(master);}else gain.connect(master);o.start(t);o.stop(t+spec[2]+.03);}catch(_){}}

/* ---------- mre\u017ea (MQTT preko javnog servera, radi sa bilo koje mre\u017ee) ---------- */
function connectBroker(url,ok,bad){let done=false,c;
 try{c=mqtt.connect(url,{clientId:'kb'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10)+Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4),clean:true,connectTimeout:7000,reconnectPeriod:0,keepalive:30})}catch(e){bad();return}
 const to=setTimeout(()=>{if(done)return;done=true;try{c.end(true)}catch(e){}bad()},8500);
 c.on('connect',()=>{if(!done){done=true;clearTimeout(to);try{c.options.reconnectPeriod=2000}catch(e){}cli=c;c.on('message',netMsg);ok()}else if(cli===c&&subs.length)try{c.subscribe(subs,{qos:0})}catch(e){}});
 c.on('error',()=>{if(done)return;done=true;clearTimeout(to);try{c.end(true)}catch(e){}bad()});
 c.on('close',()=>{if(done)return;done=true;clearTimeout(to);try{c.end(true)}catch(e){}bad()})}
function netMsg(topic,buf){let d;try{d=JSON.parse(buf.toString())}catch(e){return}if(!d||typeof d!=='object')return;

 else if(!MP.role&&joinT)preJoin(d)}
function peerIn(d){if(!MP.role||typeof d.f!=='string'||d.f.length>=24||d.f===myPid)return;
 if(!MP.roster.some(r=>r.pid===d.f))return;const s=cleanState(d.s);if(s)setPeer(d.f,s)}

function hostStart(){if(MP.view==='busy')return;MP.err='';busy('Pravim sobu\u2026');

  connectBroker(BROKERS[i],()=>{if(MP.view!=='busy'){try{cli.end(true)}catch(e){}cli=null;return}
   const code=genCode();base=NS+code;hT=base+'/h';gT=base+'/g';subs=[hT,gT];
   cli.subscribe(subs,{qos:0},err=>{if(err||MP.view!=='busy'){fail('Ne mogu da napravim sobu. Probaj ponovo.');return}
    MP.role='host';MP.code=code;myPid='host';MP.roster=[{pid:'host',c:null}];MP.started=false;MP.view='lobby';wantAuto=true;timer=setInterval(netTick,50);render()})},
   ()=>go(i+1))};

function hostIn(pid,d){if(d.t==='join')onJoin(pid);else if(d.t==='bye')dropGuest(pid,conns.get(pid));else if(conns.has(pid))hostData(pid,d)}
function onJoin(pid){if(MP.role!=='host')return;const old=conns.get(pid);

function dropGuest(pid,conn){if(!conn||conns.get(pid)!==conn)return;conns.delete(pid);gst.delete(pid);MP.peers.delete(pid);MP.roster=MP.roster.filter(r=>r.pid!==pid);bcastLobby()}
function hostData(pid,d){rx.set(pid,now());if(!d||typeof d!=='object')return;

function joinStart(code){code=String(code||'').toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g,'');MP.lastCode=code;
